name: Regular Meeting of the Parks & Recreation Commission
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION

  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  (562) 865-6262

  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 25, 2023

  6:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

SPECIAL PROCEDURES

In order to reduce the risk of spreading coronavirus (COVID-19) and pursuant to the
Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20, public observation and participation
will be facilitated by the following means:

Members of the public may observe and provide public comments in-person in the
Albert O. Little Community Center subject to posted COVID-19 protocols. Public
comments may also be submitted by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us or by
leaving a voicemail at (562) 865-6262, extension 200. Comment submitted before 4:00
pm on the date of the meeting will be read until the time limit of three minutes has been
reached.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS
Public comments received prior to the commencement of the meeting will be read at
this time. Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20 minutes will be
heard at the end of the meeting. If a member of the public submitted public comments
on an item on the agenda, the public comment will be read at that time. Under the
provisions of the Brown Act, the Parks and Recreation Commission is prohibited from
taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the matter to staff
or to a subsequent meeting.

NEW BUSINESS

  1. Updated Parks & Recreation Fee Schedule
  2. New and upcoming programming for Spring-Summer 2023
  3. Fundraising for Repair & Maintenance of Artesia Park Snack Bar
  1
 COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS

  Adjournment to the next Regular Parks and Recreation Commission Meeting to
  be held on Wednesday, April 26, 2023, at 6:00 P.M.

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please
contact City Hall at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
